review_description: Josh is a strong communicator and very professional in his quoting. He worked with me to figure out what was the best set up for a custom off grid dwelling, and offered much more input and expertise than other outfits. His pricing is very competitive so naturally I engaged Everyday Energy to install. The installation process was extremely well done and very tidy. I would highly recommend Josh to anyone looking for a solar and battery setup.

Very happy with the quoting process: the response to my request for a quote was quick and comprehensive. All follow up questions were responded to promptly.Problem free installation. Everyday Energy worked well with the builders of my house so that it could be done in a timely manner.Excellent customer service both during and post installation. Josh kept me updated on progress throughout the installation. Any time I had/ have a question I feel comfortable contacting Josh who responds, and takes action when required, in good time and is able to explain things to me in layperson's terms.

How was the sales/quoting process? easilyHow did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual? yes to all, especially punctual, (I hate waiting hours for tradies, which didn't happen here at all).How was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install? all good so far.

Josh was prompt on arriving at agreed meeting times and took the time to visit our home to survey the job. Although a difficult difficult job, Josh came up with a plan which was executed to perfection.I am very happy with the system, installation and the quality service provided.

From sales to installation - the process with Everyday Energy was very smooth.Josh provided several options upfront catering for different price points and was happy to tailor these to meet our needs. Being able to talk to the installer directly during the pre-sales process (rather than a sales team) made us comfortable with our choice.Josh and his team provided a quality installation and clearly take pride their work.
Excellent communication and quality installation overall. Extensive knowledge to help you work through all the options.
Getting installed in February, but Josh supplied 4 options of various systems which was great, communications have been terrific and he is easy to deal with

The whole process from initial quote to the completion of the install was excellent. Josh is punctual, easy to deal with, answered all our questions, does quality work & cleans up any mess. I would not hesitate to recommend Josh & his team.

Quote process went well, installer was very patient and managed to quote for solar and an EV charger.Very happy with the install, most wiring in the wall and a large system for charging.Currently in the process of grid connection, being handled by installer.
Top installer. Pleasant ,helpful and punctual. Very happy. We were given good advice on options.
Joshua offered a competitive price and did a great job on site. Highly recommended.
We were well advised and assisted at every stage and were helped to fully understand the process. . Really professional install. Trustworthy, timely and tidy

I recently had Everyday Energy install a remarkable 13.3kw solar system at my place, and I am thoroughly impressed. Their professionalism, work ethic, and attention to detail were outstanding. From start to finish, Josh and the team showcased exceptional expertise and delivered flawless results. The installation was completed on time, and the system is already generating significant energy savings. I highly recommend Everyday Energy for their exceptional workmanship and customer satisfaction.
